title.purpose: Wordmark and section headings inside panels.

label.purpose: Metadata, distances, counts, attribution. The floor is 12px.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Hovered cards, primary button, map markers.

motion.name: spring-snappy
motion.purpose: Taps compress to 97%; tooltips, menus and morphing labels. Settles in about 200 ms.

motion.name: spring-smooth
motion.purpose: The dock's entrance and the search bar's width.

motion.name: spring-morph
motion.purpose: Shared-layout indicators: the chip wash and the trail ring.

motion.name: spring-sheet
motion.purpose: The place sheet slides and settles; drag past 96px or a flick dismisses.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Opacity and colour transitions, 200 to 500 ms; the intro exit.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Transforms and layout animations become instant; fades stay. The magnetic button holds still.

motion.name: input-clear-dissolve
motion.purpose: transitions.dev recipe on the search field's clear control; tokens --clear-* and --glow-* in globals.css. Instant under reduced motion.

motion.name: preview-walk
motion.value: ~32 m/s along the routed path, 12–45 s, 62° pitch, zoom 17.2
motion.purpose: The tour map flies the camera along the streets; bearing follows the street 35 m ahead. Steps stop to stop under reduced motion; any gesture hands the camera back.

motion.name: notebook-3d
motion.value: explore 55° / tour 58° pitch, extrusions #f0ede8→#d3cec6 by height under a soft warm light, terrain, Paper sky, globe when zoomed out
motion.purpose: Both maps at rest, on the Liberty data re-dressed to the notebook (lib/basemap.ts). A dock control drops a map to 2D, flat and facing north; a compass pill resets rotation.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one orange action on a screen: Plan tour, Add to walking tour, Try again. An EasyUI Button re-skinned: it compresses to 97% on tap and springs back.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-accent, #e05c1a); color: var(--color-ink, #1c1917); font: 600 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(28,25,23,0.08); transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent-strong, #c2410c); color: #fff; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-strong, #c2410c); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet pill for everything that is not the primary action.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-secondary"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71"/><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 7.07l1.71-1.71"/></svg>Copy link</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #e7e5e4); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #1c1917); font: 500 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-paper, #faf9f6); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-strong, #c2410c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sidequest Chip
components.description: Theme filter. Selected state uses Orange Wash with Deep Marker text.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #e7e5e4); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-ink-2, #57534e); font: 500 12px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 200ms, background 200ms, border-color 200ms; } .ds-chip:hover { color: var(--color-ink, #1c1917); } .ds-chip-selected, .ds-chip-selected:hover { background: var(--color-accent-soft, #fff1e8); border-color: var(--color-accent-strong, #c2410c); color: var(--color-accent-strong, #c2410c); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-strong, #c2410c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Article Card
components.description: One nearby place. The whole card opens the drawer; the title is the real button.
components.html:
11 m away

The oldest bronze statue in London and the point from which distances to the city are measured.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; width: 340px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #e7e5e4); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(28,25,23,0.05); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: box-shadow 200ms, border-color 200ms; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(28,25,23,0.08); border-color: var(--color-line-strong, #d6d3d1); } .ds-card-thumb { flex: none; width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-sunken, #f3f1ec); } .ds-card-body { min-width: 0; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-ink, #1c1917); } .ds-card-btn { all: unset; cursor: pointer; } .ds-card-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-strong, #c2410c); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-card-meta { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-accent-strong, #c2410c); } .ds-card-text { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--color-ink-2, #57534e); }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Place search on EasyUI's iOS search bar: a visually hidden label, a leading icon that turns Ink on focus, a clear control once there is text, and the submit button nested inside the field.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 44px; padding: 0 4px 0 12px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--color-line-field, #8f8a85); border-radius: 12px; color: var(--color-ink-3, #78716c); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search:focus-within { color: var(--color-ink, #1c1917); } .ds-search:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-strong, #c2410c); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-search input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; height: 100%; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #1c1917); font: 400 14px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--color-ink-3, #78716c); } .ds-search-go { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-accent, #e05c1a); color: var(--color-ink, #1c1917); cursor: pointer; } .ds-search-go:hover { background: var(--color-accent-strong, #c2410c); color: #fff; } .ds-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); } .ds-focus:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-strong, #c2410c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Floating Dock
components.description: The toolbar that floats over the map, built on EasyUI's small floating dock. A 44px Surface pill sized to content; 36px items with a 44px hit area lift 1px on hover; the primary action is nested at the end.
components.css: .ds-dock { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; height: 44px; width: max-content; padding: 4px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #e7e5e4); border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(28,25,23,0.14); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-dock-item { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #1c1917); font: 500 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 9999px; transition: background 150ms, transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-dock-item::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -4px 0; } .ds-dock-item:hover { background: var(--color-paper, #faf9f6); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-dock-div { width: 1px; height: 20px; margin: 0 2px; background: var(--color-line, #e7e5e4); } .ds-dock-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-accent, #e05c1a); color: var(--color-ink, #1c1917); font: 600 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(28,25,23,0.08); } .ds-dock-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent-strong, #c2410c); color: #fff; } .ds-focus:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-strong, #c2410c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Select
components.description: Search radius on EasyUI's spring select: the menu rides a snappy spring below a 44px field and the chevron rotates a hair past 180°. The highlighted option is Sunken; the chosen one is Deep Marker with a check.
components.html:
• Within 500 m
  • Within 1 km
  • Within 2 km
components.css: .ds-select { position: relative; width: 220px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-select-trigger { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--color-line-field, #8f8a85); border-radius: 12px; color: var(--color-ink, #1c1917); font: 500 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-select-trigger[aria-expanded='true'] { border-color: var(--color-accent-strong, #c2410c); } .ds-select-trigger svg { color: var(--color-ink-3, #78716c); transform: rotate(192deg); } .ds-select-menu { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; margin: 6px 0 0; padding: 4px; list-style: none; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #e7e5e4); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(28,25,23,0.14); } .ds-select-menu li { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--color-ink, #1c1917); font: 400 14px/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-select-menu li[aria-selected='true'] { color: var(--color-accent-strong, #c2410c); font-weight: 500; } .ds-select-menu li.is-active { background: var(--color-sunken, #f3f1ec); } .ds-focus:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-strong, #c2410c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sheet
components.description: The place panel on EasyUI's sheet: slides in from the right on desktop, rises as a bottom sheet on phones, and can be dragged or flicked away. Surface panel, Float shadow, Ink scrim at 20%, no blur.
components.html:
Nelson's Column

Monument in Trafalgar Square
components.css: .ds-sheet-scrim { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(28,25,23,0.2); } .ds-sheet { position: fixed; right: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 420px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #1c1917); border-left: 1px solid var(--color-line, #e7e5e4); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(28,25,23,0.14); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-sheet-grab { display: none; height: 28px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-sheet-grab span { width: 36px; height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--color-line-strong, #d6d3d1); } .ds-sheet-close { position: absolute; top: 12px; right: 12px; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95); color: var(--color-ink, #1c1917); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(28,25,23,0.08); cursor: pointer; } .ds-sheet-body { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 20px; } .ds-sheet-body h2 { margin: 0; font: 700 20px/1.3 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-sheet-body p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--color-ink-2, #57534e); font-size: 14px; } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-sheet { top: auto; left: 0; max-height: 92dvh; width: auto; border-left: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-line, #e7e5e4); border-radius: 16px 16px 0 0; } .ds-sheet-grab { display: flex; } } .ds-focus:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-strong, #c2410c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Trail

components.html:
1. 1
    Equestrian statue of Charles I

    22 m, under 1 min to stop 2

  2. 2
    Charing Cross

    36 m, under 1 min to stop 3

  3. 3
    Parliament Street from Trafalgar Square
components.css: .ds-trail { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 340px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-trail li { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px 1fr; column-gap: 12px; } .ds-trail li:not(:last-child)::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 13.5px; top: 44px; bottom: 0; width: 1px; background: var(--color-line, #e7e5e4); } .ds-trail li.is-done:not(:last-child)::before { background: var(--color-ink, #1c1917); } .ds-trail-dot { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; margin-top: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line-strong, #d6d3d1); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #1c1917); font: 700 12px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .is-done .ds-trail-dot { background: var(--color-ink, #1c1917); border-color: var(--color-ink, #1c1917); color: #fff; } .is-current .ds-trail-dot { background: var(--color-accent, #e05c1a); border-color: var(--color-accent, #e05c1a); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(28,25,23,0.08); } .is-current .ds-trail-dot::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -5px; border: 1px solid var(--color-accent-strong, #c2410c); border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-trail-card { padding: 16px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #e7e5e4); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(28,25,23,0.05); font: 600 14px/1.35 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink, #1c1917); } .is-current .ds-trail-card { border-color: var(--color-accent, #e05c1a); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(28,25,23,0.08); } .ds-trail-leg { grid-column: 2; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0; color: var(--color-ink-2, #57534e); font: 500 12px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Morphing Button
components.description: EasyUI's morphing button: the label changes in place without the control changing size. Copy link becomes Copied with a Success check; Add to walking tour becomes Added to your tour.
components.html: <button class="ds-morph ds-focus"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/></svg>Copied</button>
components.css: .ds-morph { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 116px; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--color-line-strong, #d6d3d1); border-radius: 12px; color: var(--color-ink, #1c1917); font: 600 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-morph svg { color: var(--color-success, #15803d); } .ds-morph:hover { background: var(--color-paper, #faf9f6); } .ds-focus:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-strong, #c2410c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: EasyUI's skeleton: Sunken blocks with a slow light sweep, shaped like the content they stand in for.
components.css: .ds-skel-card { display: flex; gap: 12px; width: 340px; padding: 16px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #e7e5e4); border-radius: 16px; } .ds-skel-card > div { flex: 1; padding-top: 4px; } .ds-skel { position: relative; display: block; height: 12px; margin-bottom: 10px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-sunken, #f3f1ec); overflow: hidden; } .ds-skel-thumb { width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 12px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-skel::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.7), transparent); animation: ds-sweep 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-sweep { from { transform: translateX(-100%); } to { transform: translateX(100%); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-skel::after { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Detour is a map you annotate while walking. The interface borrows the materials of a notebook kept in a coat pocket: warm paper, dark ink, and one orange marker pen used sparingly to say "here". Everything that is not the map or the story is quiet, so the basemap's own colour and the article photographs are the only pictures on screen.

The product runs in Operate mode: the visitor is in a task (find, read, plan) and the interface should disappear into it. Density is moderate, controls are the ones people already know from maps apps, and the single family does every job. Motion only reports state, with one authored exception, the welcome sequence, which shows once per session and can always be skipped.

The controls are EasyUI primitives (components/ui, installed through the shadcn registry) re-skinned to this system. EasyUI supplies the mechanics: spring taps, a floating dock, a draggable sheet, a select that rides a spring, labels that morph in place, skeletons with a light sweep, a stepper trail. The notebook supplies every colour, radius, size and shadow. A registry component's own palette never ships.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white paper with pure white surfaces lifted on it; no dark chrome anywhere.
One accent. Bright orange marks places and carries big actions; a deeper orange handles small text so it reads.
Ink text on the bright orange, never white on it.
One icon family (Lucide), one type family (Inter), no emoji in the interface.
Opaque panels. Blur is never used as decoration.
Physical motion from one token file: short springs that settle without bouncing, instant under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Ink-on-Orange Rule
rules.body: Text that sits on Marker Orange is Ink. White on the bright orange fails contrast and is never used, including on badges.

rules.name: The Small-Text Rule
rules.body: Orange text below 18px, and any orange icon that carries meaning, uses Deep Marker. Marker Orange is for fills, pins and lines.

rules.name: The One Marker Rule
rules.body: Orange appears on fewer than one in ten elements of any screen: pins, the selected item, the primary action, and nothing else.

rules.name: The Twelve Pixel Floor
rules.body: Functional text is never smaller than 12px. Attribution and keyboard hints included.

rules.name: The Balanced Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings wrap with text-wrap: balance; paragraphs with text-wrap: pretty.

rules.name: The No-Blur Rule
rules.body: Panels are opaque. Nothing uses backdrop-filter; the map is expensive to repaint and a frosted edge over it is decoration.

dos: Do set text on Marker Orange in Ink, and orange text below 18px in Deep Marker.
Do build icons from Lucide at 16px (chips, metadata) or 18px (toolbar) with a 2px stroke.
Do size floating controls to their content with width: max-content and a 16px viewport gutter.
Do give every control a visible focus ring, a name, and keyboard activation; divs are never clickable.
Do keep panels opaque and let depth come from Surface-on-Paper plus the three shadows.
Do build new controls from the EasyUI primitives in components/ui, re-skinned with these tokens before they ship.
donts: Don't use emoji as icons anywhere in the interface.
Don't put an eyebrow or kicker label above a heading; the heading carries its own weight.
Don't use backdrop-filter on any panel over the map.
Don't reintroduce dark chrome: dark pills, dark splash screens, or dark error pages.
Don't keep a registry component's own palette, glow or 11px labels; the mechanics come from EasyUI, the look comes from here.
